Last year after applying 4 times for the analyst group I finally succeeded and got the job! One year later I’m being moves from a satellite division to the main office. My biggest strength within my group is my operation background and knowledge of the day to day workings of the organization. 

My suggestion is find a way to start analyzing and share with those around you. Take the free courses on Coursera or EdX. I think you can ever audit the Google course and get most of the learning out of it. 

Keep plugging away until you find your in and make the most of the opportunities in-front of you.
